params.name: disclaimerTypes
params.description:
Request for one or more disclaimer types, as a comma-separated list.
This will filter the response to show only the specified disclaimerType(s)

params.name: state
params.description:
Case insensitive
Only applicable for disclaimerType = `vg`
If omitted, all state VG disclaimers will be returned as an array
If the requested disclaimerType is not `vg` this field will be ignored.

params.name: asAtDate
params.description:
The as-at date enables a requester to retrieve the disclaimer version that was valid at a specific point in time.
This is useful where your implementation is sensitive to text changes, such as a printed PDF, as disclaimer texts are updated from time-to-time.
If as-at date is omitted from the request, the response will provide the current disclaimer version.

params.name: textFormat
params.description:
Providing an optional text format will enable the requester to control the formatting of the disclaimerContent field on the response.
HTML or Plaintext formatting is supported

items.docs:
Endpoint for retrieving data source disclaimer texts. 
These texts are required to be displayed in user experiences and printed reports when utilising PropTrack data - refer to the [Disclaimers](https://developer.proptrack.com.au/docs/apis/disclaimers) page for an implementation guide.
